name: Colldejou (Spain)
description: White field with a red horizontal stripe in the upper part and a dark green horizontal stripe in the lower part.
history: The official flag of Colldejou is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, white, with a red fess of thickness 1/6 of the height set at 1/4 from the upper edge and another equal dark green fess at 1/4 from the lower edge; approved on 8 February 2005 and published in the DOGC on 2 March 2005.

features.role: stripe of 1/6 set at 1/4 from the upper edge
stripe of 1/6 set at 1/4 from the lower edge
